text:
sam: Heads-up — Albatross Analytics cutover proposal: 2026-03-24 02:00-03:00 UTC. Need go/no-go and final KMS/traffic approvals. Pin to runtime v2.14.0 for the migration.

amy: Ack. I reviewed the runbook, left a note about the cache priming step. Can we confirm canary is 5% and auto-rollback thresholds?

jordan: 5% canary + 10 minute observation window sounds right. Rollback trigger: 5% error rate OR 30% latency p95 increase.

sam: Agree with thresholds. Ops: confirm KMS rotation won't collide with their key rotation window? @leo

leo: Leo: KMS team ok — albatross key rotation scheduled for 2026-03-26 so no collision. I've added a key-access check in the preflight.

deploybot: deploybot: Dry-run (canary) for customer=albatross, version=v2.14.0 succeeded. Logs: https://deploy.internal/runs/4825678901-dryrun

amy: Nice. One req: pin model-variant to quantized-x8 in the slice config to avoid an unexpected kernel selection. I added the patch to the release notes.

ops-bot: ops-bot: FYI — Reserved capacity for albatross slice s-07 allocated (3 GPU workers) for window 02:00-04:00 UTC. Billing alert auto-enabled.

sam: All good from infra. Can we get final signoff from product/security? Jordan, amy — you good?

jordan: Product: good. Confirmed user-visible latency targets set in the ticket.

amy: Security: good. KMS, audit logs, and egress rules validated.

sam: OK locking schedule. Action items: 1) Ops to run preflight script at -60m 2) Deploybot to execute canary at 02:00 3) Observation at +10m 4) If thresholds exceeded -> automatic rollback; manual escalation to oncall if partial degradation.

leo: I'll run preflight and post a short status in this thread at -55m.

deploybot: deploybot: Scheduled deploy job created: `deploy --customer albatross --slice s-07 --version v2.14.0 --canary 5% --observe 10m` — Job ID 4825680001.

sam: Thanks. Tagging release notes as final: https://confluence/release/albatross-2026-03-24. Please don't edit after lock.

jordan: Quick note — if we see KVCACHE warm-up failing, fallback plan is to serve traffic to v2.13.8-compatible variant for 30m.

amy: Copy. I'll keep a checklist open and monitor logs. :eyes:

leo: preflight complete — all green. KMS keys accessible, DB read replicas synced, cache primed.

sam: Final sign-off: sam: APPROVED. Good luck team :rocket:

deploybot: deploybot: Job 4825680001 started at 2026-03-24T02:00:12Z. Canary healthy at +4m.

ops-bot: ops-bot: Metric snapshot at +10m — errors 0.9%, p95 latency +4%. Within thresholds.

jordan: Thanks all. I'll keep watch for the remainder of the window.

sam: Closing thread after 03:15 UTC if all remains green. If not, reopen and escalate. :lock:
